Massless characteristic homogeneity permits exact radial integration for the selected collisionless problem: qbar=I3/I2 with number weights reproduces both N^a and T^ab at every time. Planck qbar=2.701178032919063896... . This does not preserve I4, full spectral information, recoil or energy-dependent collisions. The 32-fold photon radial state-count reduction is not a measured 32-fold total speedup.

All grids share continuum Z_m. No per-grid density fitting hides quadrature error. Massive FD is 1/(exp(q)+1), not equilibrium in particle energy. The original clipped exponential remains a distinct finite-node source.

## Original executed evidence, recovered without replay

- Six fixed states: 60 unique grid/moment evaluations plus one targeted stronger Planck reference; selected normalized difference 1.0916905982446595e-8. Independent MP55 LRS Planck oracle difference 2.6257077617842288e-14.

- Thirteen unique pytest items: source8 + final driver5. Original RED/GREEN and initial driver tests' missed-RHS limitation are preserved; duplicate test calls are not summed as unique tests.
- Near-isotropic Planck pi failed the first RHS due to separately rounded P_ab/P_ba reductions. The new six-component symmetric bridge fixes representation without changing donor physics, widening tolerances or projecting density/positivity.
- Three PNG/SVG/CSV figure sets and one retained legend-only repair. Serial mathematical/code audit and distinct CAS/scalar references; fresh independent model/subagent review NOT_RUN.

The Q48 tail bound1.594110021502003e-13 for actual amplitudes is conditional on a COMMON prescribed geometry and the stated envelope. It is not a nonlinear coupled-trajectory or interval certificate.

## Publication recovery and preservation

The interrupted science was already complete in a 219,594,596-byte S2 archive.
